tldr: Mars in the 8th house routes drive and action through shared depth and vulnerability.
body: With Mars in the 8th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through shared resources, trust, intimacy, debt, grief, and deep repair. This makes how you merge, trust, release control, and handle what cannot stay superficial a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through shared depth and vulnerability.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in shared depth and vulnerability.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
